Staring At Robust Growth Opportunity The global engineered stone industry is expected to grow at a 6% CAGR between 2027 and 2032, reaching US$ 48,104 million by 2032, with engineered quartz remaining the major contributor within the segment.
The Indian engineered stone market, valued at approximately $3,643 million in 2022, is projected to grow at a CAGR of 7-8% between 2022 and 2027, and is expected to reach $7,355 million by 2032.
Growth & demand: While the Company's business was initially export-oriented, it launched its premium brand 'Haique' (originally 'Haiqu') to capitalize on the growing demand for engineered stones in the domestic market.
2019  Launched 'Haique' as its brand for Luxury Surfaces  Increased production capacity for Engineered Quartz Surfaces by installing 2nd Pressing Line.
2026  Launched one of its kind Marketing Campaign by strategic collaboration with Architects & Interior Designer redefining luxury as “Maison Fashion”.
Margins & costs: The Company also commissioned a facility for manufacturing quartz grit and quartz powder, the primary raw material used in engineered quartz production, strengthening its backward integration and control over raw material quality.
Heightened tariff measures on exports to the USA, coupled with volatility in raw material and logistics costs, weighed on the sector's performance.
